key_insight: LLM-driven, verifiable compilation redesigns Shor’s arithmetic pipeline to bring expected RSA-2048 factoring costs below one billion Toffoli gates.
engineering_relevance: The resulting circuit frontier offers lower logical resource costs, with trade-offs between qubit count and Toffoli count.
method: Use LLM-driven search to redesign arithmetic stages in an approximate residue number system.
Compile circuit candidates deterministically into a qubit–Toffoli Pareto frontier.
Bound rare overflows analytically and verify elementary gate sequences on representative circuits.
evidence_signal: Against Gidney’s 2025 baseline with matched adder accounting, the abstract reports a 70.1% reduction in minimum qubit–Toffoli product and up to 78.6% fewer expected factoring Toffolis at matched accumulator precision.
watch_item: These logical resource savings do not establish practical runtime or physical-qubit requirements on fault-tolerant hardware.
paper_title: Reducing RSA-2048 Factoring Resources Below One Billion Toffolis via LLM-Driven Verifiable Quantum Compilation
